theorems.name: Submission.lpf_pi_simple_unit_facts
theorems.statement: ((∀ (P n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → Eucl P), ‖simpleNVector v‖ ^ 2 = (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (v i) (v j)).det) ∧ ∀ (P n : ℕ) (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (τ : Fin n → Eucl P), simpleNVector (fun i => ∑ j, B i j • τ j) = B.det • simpleNVector τ) → (∀ (Q n : ℕ) (σ : Fin n → Eucl Q), Orthonormal ℝ σ → ‖simpleNVector σ‖ = 1) ∧ ∀ (Q n : ℕ) (σ σ' : Fin n → Eucl Q), Orthonormal ℝ σ → Orthonormal ℝ σ' → Submodule.span ℝ (range σ) = Submodule.span ℝ (range σ') → simpleNVector σ' = simpleNVector σ ∨ simpleNVector σ' = -simpleNVector σ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
